main_concerns.concern: This is a design/plan deliverable presented as forward progress. The strongest risk is 'document as completion': the main AI may satisfy itself with a convincing hardening proposal while the runner remains unpatched and the next E2E run would fail the same way. The review request does not contain a code diff, a validation run, or a changed session_id artifact.

--ignore-user-config 与项目级 Hook/session_id 采集的兼容性完全未经验证。这是四个 review question 中最关键的一个（Q2: "是否会破坏项目级 Hook 或角色 session_id 采集？"），但方案没有提供任何 CLI 行为验证。如果该标志导致 Hook 不触发，修复将引入比 420 秒超时更严重的问题：整个 session 溯源链和证据链不可验证，直接违反约束"不能取消项目级 Hook、session_id"。

minimum_fixes.minimum_fix: Implement the runner changes now, then run at least a focused validation. The next deliverable must include: (1) the code diff, (2) runtime logs showing the new CLI flags in the command line, (3) a successful role artifact, (4) the final session_id captured from the Hook of the successful attempt, and (5) retry evidence artifacts for any preceding failed attempt. Do not advance by producing another design document.

在修改 complete_revival_e2e.py 之前必须完成：1) 在隔离 Codex CLI 环境中执行 codex exec --ignore-user-config 并验证项目级 Hook 是否正常触发、session_id 是否采集；2) 如果 --ignore-user-config 确实会阻止 Hook，替代方案应为显式覆盖参数（--model-reasoning-effort medium）而非全局忽略用户配置，或使用 --no-plugins 逐个禁用插件；3) 定义双重失败的降级策略（标记失败 + 保留两次失败证据 + 不阻塞其他角色继续执行）。
